# Goal
mado round 36, wave 1 — build and first falsifiers. /skill:godspeed

You are a Godspeed-enabled subagent.
1. Name the axes.
2. Iterate cheap, in parallel.
3. Keep moves that improve any axis and harm none.
4. Don't aim — let the frontier walk itself.
IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel.

Lane repo (call it LANE): /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin
Every lane path you touch is ABSOLUTE under that root. Your tools start at the FLEET root (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), so a relative lane path lands in the wrong repo. Every `Report:` trailer path the renderer gives you is relative to LANE — write it at LANE/<that path>.

## The freeze (read-only; never edit)
LANE/.ufo/waves/round-36/registration.md — two claims, both predicates frozen at commit dbf8b579aeac0f023aaf595770f1cb0049e4baa2 before any round-36 data:
- C1 calibration: LANE/quality/check-counter-discrimination.py scores a frozen 25-control manifest (3 accept, 22 reject) over an admission counter; target `correct == controls`; before = 14/25 (LANE/.ufo/waves/round-36/receipts/before-discrimination.txt). The repaired counters do NOT exist yet (LANE/quality/counters/ is this round's data), so attack the DESIGN, the CONTROLS, the FROZEN SPECS and the GATES.
- C2 operability: LANE/quality/check-evidence-pointers.py (PRED-PTR-r36-v1) over the lane's own records; before = TARGET_MISSED (receipts/before-pointers.txt).
Manifest: LANE/.ufo/waves/round-36/controls/manifest.json. Frozen specs: LANE/.ufo/waves/round-36/{c1,c2}/frozen.json. Fixture generator: LANE/.ufo/waves/round-36/c2/gen-mutants.py. Round-35 routed defects: LANE/corpus/lessons/round-35-verifier-spotcheck.md (D1–D10).

## Bounds (hard)
- READ-ONLY on every production file. Write ONLY your own report and, if you need scratch, LANE/.ufo/waves/round-36/scratch/<YourName>/ plus /tmp. Never edit LANE/quality/, LANE/corpus/, LANE/tools/, LANE/LOG.md, LANE/SCORECARD.md, LANE/SKILL.md, LANE/PROVINCE.md, or anything under LANE/.ufo/waves/round-36/{registration.md,controls,receipts,c1,c2,ledger,c2/mutants}. Never write the fleet root's scripts/ or templates/, /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/ (operator-owned) or /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow (read-only campaign source). Never touch a sibling lane repo.
- Never mutate a compositor, a config tree, a service or a package; no hyprctl write verbs. The host's live planes are read-only for this lane.
- Never pass a `model` parameter to anything; the host role map routes. Never message `agent://all`; seats only by id.
- Tooling: you MAY install or upgrade tools that help (read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first). PACMAN IS PAUSED HOST-WIDE: run no pacman transaction of any kind; use `uv tool`, `npx`, or an official binary into ~/.local/bin. Record every install (tool, version, channel, reason) in your report.
- No fabricated evidence: a command you did not run has not passed. Quote the exact output lines you rely on.

## Deliverable
Your report: what you checked, the exact commands, the quoted output, and a PASS/FAIL/finding verdict per item, with file:line or command-output pointers. If an item is impossible as written, say what blocked it and what you ran instead.
